anytime_first_td_scorer.label: Anytime, first and next TD scorer
anytime_first_td_scorer.target: Probability that a player scores a touchdown (first, next, or any) as defined by contract; no-score mass for first-TD markets.

combos_and_parlays.label: Multi-leg combo and parlay markets
combos_and_parlays.target: Joint probability that all legs resolve as required.

first_half_and_quarter_totals.label: First-half, second-half and quarter totals, spreads and winners
first_half_and_quarter_totals.target: Probability for period winner/halftime-fulltime result/ quarter or half total/spread rungs under tie and overtime rules.

first_score_team_time_race.label: First TD team, first TD time and race-to-N points
first_score_team_time_race.target: Which team scores first TD (or reaches N points first) and the game-time bucket of the first TD.

game_events.label: Game events and stats (overtime, safety, both teams score, TD counts, team stats)
game_events.target: Occurrence or count of game events: overtime, safety, defensive/special-teams TD, total TDs, period TDs, team stat thresholds.

game_moneyline_spread.label: Game moneyline, spread and win-margin buckets
game_moneyline_spread.target: Probability a team wins (with or without overtime per wording), covers a spread rung, or wins by a margin bucket.

game_total.label: Game total points and both-teams-score
game_total.target: Probability that total points exceed a rung (with or without OT per wording) or that both teams score at least N points.

off_field_events.label: Draft, coach, transaction and Super Bowl novelty events
off_field_events.target: Occurrence or outcome of off-field events per official announcement or defined source.

player_availability.label: Player availability, starter and snap-role events
player_availability.target: Whether a named player is active, starts, or meets a role threshold (snaps, designation) per contract source.

qb_passing_tds_and_ints.label: QB passing TD and interception counts
qb_passing_tds_and_ints.target: Probability a QB throws at least N touchdown passes, or at least N interceptions (or both), in the game as officially scored.

qb_passing_yards.label: QB passing yards ladder
qb_passing_yards.target: Probability a quarterback's official regulation-and-overtime passing yards exceed each rung (e.g. 199.5 to 349.5), or exceed another QB (H2H).

receiving_yards_and_receptions.label: Receiving yards and receptions
receiving_yards_and_receptions.target: Probability a player's receiving yards or receptions exceed a threshold (or exceed another player) in the game.

rushing_yards.label: Player rushing yards and attempts
rushing_yards.target: Probability a player's rushing yards (or attempts) exceed a threshold, or exceed another player.

season_awards.label: Season awards (MVP, OPOY, DPOY, ROY and similar)
season_awards.target: Which candidate is named winner of an annual award by the official body.

season_player_stats_and_leaders.label: Season player stats, leaders, weekly leaders and fantasy
season_player_stats_and_leaders.target: Probability a player or team reaches a season (or weekly) statistical threshold, leads the league, or outranks another in a stat.

season_win_totals_and_futures.label: Season win totals, playoffs, division, conference and Super Bowl futures
season_win_totals_and_futures.target: Probability of season-long team outcomes: win count thresholds or exact wins, playoffs, division, seed, conference title, Super Bowl, head-to-head season comparisons.

team_total.label: Team total points
team_total.target: Probability one team's points exceed a rung in the game, per wording on overtime.

unreg:extreme_play_length.label: Longest/shortest play, touchdown and field-goal extremes
unreg:extreme_play_length.target: Probability that the maximum (or minimum) play length of a type over a window exceeds or falls below a yardage threshold.

unreg:fantasy_points_markets.label: NFL fantasy-point markets (player totals, weekly leaders, head-to-head, ladders)
unreg:fantasy_points_markets.target: A player's full-PPR fantasy points in a game or period, or rank among players or head-to-head.

unreg:nfl_draft_selection.label: NFL Draft and Supplemental Draft selection markets
unreg:nfl_draft_selection.target: Probability a named prospect is selected at a slot, range or positional order, or a team makes/uses a given pick, per the official Draft results.

unreg:super_bowl_mvp.label: Super Bowl MVP and its position/defense/non-QB variants
unreg:super_bowl_mvp.target: Probability a player (or position group) is named Super Bowl MVP, given the game outcome and in-game performance.

unreg:team_and_event_counting_specials.label: NFL team and event counting specials
unreg:team_and_event_counting_specials.target: A team or game count (first downs, field goals, interceptions, sacks) or a rare event (safety, tie, largest lead) relative to a threshold.
